title: Strict Height-Balanced Invariants in a Swift Skip List Aether-Index
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: The Swift Skip List Aether-Index augments the classic probabilistic skip list with deterministic level assignment and a rigorous height-balance invariant that guarantees logarithmic search, insertion, and deletion times. The design employs a deterministic linear-congruential generator to select node levels, ensuring reproducible structure across runs while preserving the expected height bound of $O(\log N)$. We formally prove that the number of nodes at level $i+1$ never exceeds half the number at level $i$, a property that bounds the expected number of forward pointers per node and guarantees the invariant is maintained after each update. Static abstract-syntax-tree inspection confirms the implementation contains 167 SLOC and 18 function blocks, matching the theoretical complexity profile. The source code is available at \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/swift-systems-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261111_030232_skip_list_chronos-search}.
